##### Project general facts

Aquino at Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah is a refined waterfront residential development that redefines coastal living through a balance of elegance, tranquility, and contemporary design. Set along the shores of the Arabian Gulf, this low-rise community offers a peaceful retreat where architecture and nature exist in perfect harmony, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury and calm.

The project is characterized by its clean architectural lines, open layouts, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. Floor-to-ceiling windows allow natural light to fill each residence while framing panoramic sea views, enhancing the sense of space and connection to the surrounding environment. Every home is thoughtfully designed to combine functionality with aesthetic appeal, offering residents a comfortable and sophisticated living experience.

Aquino is envisioned as more than just a residence — it is a lifestyle destination shaped by serenity and natural beauty. Lush landscaped areas, ocean-facing amenities, and carefully curated interiors create a setting where everyday life feels like a retreat. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, equipped kitchens, and come fully furnished, providing a turnkey solution for those seeking effortless coastal living in one of the UAE’s most scenic destinations.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
